features.name: n_events
features.definition: completed URBs per 1 s window

features.name: ev_rate
features.definition: n_events / window length

features.name: mean_iat
features.definition: mean inter-arrival time between consecutive completions; = 1.0 if < 2 events

features.name: std_iat
features.definition: standard deviation of inter-arrival times; 0 if < 2 events

features.name: cv_iat
features.definition: std_iat / mean_iat; 0 if < 2 events (a degenerate value: see finding 36)

features.name: min_iat
features.definition: smallest inter-arrival time; = 1.0 if < 2 events

features.name: p10_iat
features.definition: 10th percentile inter-arrival time; = 1.0 if < 2 events

features.name: iat_entropy
features.definition: Shannon entropy of the log10 inter-arrival histogram, 12 bins over 1e-4..10 s, divided by ln 12; 0 if < 2 inter-arrivals

features.name: burstiness_fano
features.definition: variance / mean of event counts in ten 0.1 s sub-windows (1 = Poisson, ~0 = regular, >1 = bursty)

features.name: mean_len
features.definition: mean URB data length

features.name: std_len
features.definition: standard deviation of URB data length

features.name: max_len
features.definition: largest URB data length

features.name: bytes_in_rate
features.definition: sum of device-to-host data lengths / window length

features.name: bytes_out_rate
features.definition: sum of host-to-device data lengths / window length

features.name: n_endpoints
features.definition: distinct endpoints that carried traffic

features.name: frac_intr
features.definition: fraction of events that are interrupt transfers

features.name: frac_bulk
features.definition: fraction of events that are bulk transfers

features.name: frac_iso
features.definition: fraction of events that are isochronous transfers

features.name: frac_ctrl
features.definition: fraction of events that are control transfers

features.name: frac_in
features.definition: fraction of events in the device-to-host direction

features.name: payload_novelty
features.definition: distinct captured payloads / captured payloads

features.name: repeat_ratio
features.definition: count of the most frequent payload / captured payloads

features.name: payload_seq_novelty
features.definition: fraction of this window's payload transitions (consecutive pairs) never seen earlier in the device's session; 1.0 if < 2 payloads

features.name: n_interfaces
features.definition: interfaces the device has declared, as visible at window end

features.name: has_hid
features.definition: a HID interface (class 0x03) is declared

features.name: has_storage
features.definition: a mass-storage interface (class 0x08) is declared

features.name: class_behaviour_mismatch
features.definition: fraction of events whose transfer type is outside the union expected for the declared interface classes

features.name: late_iface_flag
features.definition: an interface that appeared after enumeration is visible

features.name: log_time_since_enum
features.definition: time since the device enumerated (EXCLUDED: label leak, finding 8)

features.name: concurrent_device_rate
features.definition: event rate of every other device on the host (dropped automatically: constant on a single-device corpus)

normalisation.stage1: per-feature z-score with the mean and SD of benign training windows; SD floored at 0.01 (SD_FLOOR) and the result clipped to +/-10.0 (STD_CLIP)
normalisation.stage2: per-input z-score with the mean and SD of all training sequence rows (SD clamped at 1e-6), stored in the checkpoint and applied in forward()

stage1.model: Isolation Forest per declared class group (hid, storage, av, composite), plus a generic forest over all benign windows used for groups with fewer than 30 training windows ('other')

device_baseline.type: per-device EWMA of mean and variance

stage1.output: anomaly score in [0, 1]; forest term scaled by its benign 99th percentile, device term by the benign 99th percentile of the deviation
stage1.trained_on: benign windows of the fit split only (no labels)

stage2.input: the 28 deployed features + the Stage-1 score = 29 inputs per window, as sequences of the last 10 windows, left-padded by repeating the earliest row (strictly causal)
stage2.architecture: 1-layer LSTM, hidden size 32, forget-gate bias 1; Linear(32 -> 1) on the last time step; sigmoid
stage2.output_layer: one logit -> sigmoid = probability the current window is post-onset
stage2.class_weighting: pos_weight = negative windows / positive windows in the training set (2.31 for Corpus B's fit split)
stage2.optimiser: Adam, learning rate 0.002, weight decay 0.0, gradient norm clipped at 5.0
stage2.stopping_rule: fixed 14 epochs; no early stopping. Validation recall is logged per epoch but does not select the checkpoint
stage2.labels: window y = 1 iff the window ends after the attack onset

decision.window_threshold: smallest threshold with <= 0.01 gate firings per benign device-hour on 80 h of long simulated sessions (eval.analysis_calibration, seed 4049)

threshold_history.rule: per-window FPR 0.0001 on validation benign windows

decision.gate: alert when 4 of the last 6 windows of one device are at or above the threshold; the alert is timed at the end of the completing window
decision.session_alarm: a session counts as alarmed if the gate fires at least once
decision.from_window_to_session: not analytic: windows of one device are strongly autocorrelated (consecutive Stage-2 inputs share 9 of 10 rows), so session-level false alarms are MEASURED on held-out benign sessions and long sessions (out/analysis_session_fp.json)
decision.enforcement: THROTTLE then DEAUTHORIZE are generated, logged and stored but NOT applied: ENFORCEMENT_REVIEWED is False (dry-run)

corpus_A.description: original simulator: every benign device always active

corpus_B.description: realistic simulator: duty cycles, HID key-release and rollover reports, language-like text, per-device speed; the deployed model's training data

corpus_C.description: fresh realistic set, 100 sessions per attack family + 3,000 benign; never used to train, calibrate or select

data.split_rule: by session, never by window; stratified by profile for the 30% test split, then 20% of the remainder drawn at random for validation; eval.corpus.stratified_split asserts no session crosses splits

glossary.meaning: one device's traffic in one 1-second interval; the unit the models score
of post-onset attack windows, the fraction scored at or above the threshold
of benign windows, the fraction scored at or above the threshold (the calibration target, 1e-4)
one device from attachment to removal (one simulated device run)
of attack sessions, the fraction in which the 4-of-6 gate fires at least once after onset
of benign sessions, the fraction in which the gate fires at least once
gate firings on benign devices divided by the hours those devices were observed; the unit for long-running use
time from attack onset to the end of the window that completed the gate
